text.text: NetApp disk shelves afford great flexibility, allowing users to optimize for performance and capacity, while enhancing physical data security.

graphic.text: NetApp disk shelves afford great flexibility, allowing users to optimize for performance and capacity, while enhancing physical data security.

text.text: The NS224 shelf is a 2U NVMe shelf with 24 drive slots for SSDs. Each redundant IO module (IOM) houses two 100GbE ports which makes use of the RoCEv2 RDMA over converged Ethernet protocol to provide native NVMe connectivity to supported storage controllers. The NS224 shelf supports 1.9TB, 3.8TB, 7.6TB and 15.3TB encrypted SSDs, as well as non-encrypted 1.9TB and 3.8TB SSDs.
